subject: general
question: Scurvy is caused by not having enough ________, resulting in general weakness, anaemia, gum disease and skin bleeding.
solution:
The correct answer is __**ascorbic acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Ascorbic acid

 
 
• Ascorbic acid is also known as Vitamin C.
 
• It acts as an antioxidant.
 
• It is an essential nutrient for the body as it is involved in tissue repair and enzyme-related functions.
 
• A deficiency of vitamin C can cause a disease known as scurvy.
 
• Ascorbic acid or Vitamin C is primarily present in citrus fruits like lemon, orange, guava.
 
• It has a chemical formula - C6H8O6.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cyanocobalamin

 
 
• Cyanocobalamin is a man-made form of Vitamin B12.
 
• It's used to treat and prevent vitamin B12 deficiency anaemia (when you have low levels of this vitamin in your body).
 
• Your body requires vitamin B12 to make red blood cells.
 
 
 
• **​niacin**
 
 
• Niacin is a form of Vitamin B3.
 
• Vitamin B3 is also known as Nicotinic acid.
 
• It is found in foods such as yeast, meat, fish, milk, eggs.
 
• Pellagra is caused due to deficiency of Vitamin B3.
 
 
 
• **thiamine**
 
 
• Also known as** vitamin B1**, anti-beriberi factor or anti-neurotic vitamin. 
 
• It is an important **water-soluble** vitamin
 
• It is involved in carbohydrate, fat, amino acid, glucose, and alcohol metabolism.
 
• It is essentially nontoxic.
